name: Dağ Geçidi
scene: A vintage steam locomotive crosses a mountain pass beneath flowing steam and layered alpine ridges.
notes: Target 42–52 panes. Regenerated once after visual inspection to simplify the original excessive pane count and request flat fills and a white exterior. Final sheet inspected: closed outlines, warm locomotive versus cool landscape and steam, broad mountain faces and flowing ground bands. Remaining doubts: subtle shading persists; some same-colour neighbours in the train will merge during tracing; narrow chassis segments and wheel-to-ground contacts need geometry review, and the lower landscape junction needs checking for a near four-way contact. Pane count is a design target, not a certified geometry count. Design sheet only; no tracing, game catalogue changes or finished-glass publication performed.
